title: +Splashes
description: A clean custom splash text overhaul for modern Minecraft versions.
body:
This resource pack overwrites the original vanilla splashes with community refrences!

There are splashes such as:

```
Blood for the blood god!
Say it with me. Not. Even. Close.
If you want to beat me, train for another 300 years.
Whatever you do, don't reveal all your techniques in a YouTube video, you fool, you moron.
I see you server owners... AND YOUR CHEATING!
New hut, now with no dirt!
New hut, now with dirt!
JOHN CENA!

```

This resource pack simply changes the splashes and **NOTHING** else

To report issues simply go to the report issues page in my Links, login or create a github account and click the Issues button! Or more simply in the discord server!
